title: Safe condition with a repair and maintenance program.
officialText:
The registered design professional shall not file a
report of a safe condition with a repair and maintenance program for the same building for two consecutive filing periods
unless the second such report is accompanied by his or her professional certification attesting to the correction of all
conditions identified in the prior report as requiring repair.
*ARTICLE 303
PERIODIC BOILER INSPECTIONS
*Article 303 was amended by Local Law 126 of 2021. This provision has an effective date of January 1, 2022.
